title: Experimental implementation of a discrete-time quantum walk on biological networks
summary: Quantum walks provide a versatile framework for probing the structural and dynamical properties of complex systems ranging from biological networks to synthetic materials. However, their realization on current noisy pre-fault-tolerant quantum computers is fundamentally limited by decoherence. Conventional dense encodings of graph structures require prohibitively deep circuits, making them incompatible with existing hardware.
